name: Minamikawa Satoru
source:
Hobbies: Playing the guitar
Likes: Manzai, comedy movies 

A boy who was going to the same school as [url=https://vndb.org/c50516]Yuu[/url] until half a yew ago. He left school for a particular reason, but it wasn't because he caused trouble or anything there, so he still maintains good relationships with his ex-classmates. 

He has a cheerful personality, liking to laugh and make people laugh.

[From the Official Artbook]
